topic: Pegloticase and lesinurad in refractory gout: indications, infusion reactions

source.title: 2020 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for the Management of Gout
source.whyItFits: Open ACR gout guideline that states when pegloticase is strongly recommended or strongly advised against, including infusion burden and allergic reactions, and records the regulatory status of lesinurad.

whyItFits: Open ACR gout guideline that states when pegloticase is strongly recommended or strongly advised against, including infusion burden and allergic reactions, and records the regulatory status of lesinurad.
coverageNote: Pegloticase indications and allergic/infusion burden are explicit. Lesinurad is covered as a withdrawn-but-still-approved drug whose data were considered; a dosing regimen was not copied from memory.
rejectedInAppHints: No in-app pegloticase full text was accepted. NICE NG219, which is used for catalogue 2057, does not mention pegloticase or lesinurad.
